objective: Make the canonical portfolio status fail closed when root, study, readiness, archive, promotion, or dated-ledger records contradict one another.
changes: Added a repository-native research status auditor and non-promotional JSON CLI.

Bound root study summaries to their child state files and rejected path escape, symlinks, duplicate study or family identities, unsupported promotion, forged archive state, verifier failure, and readiness contradictions.
Added an append-only Reality Ledger correction for the completed V5 and EditCLEVR studies without changing any predecessor outcome.
Added the canonical research-status audit to CI and release workflows.
Made resource-status fail closed with structured output when host counters are unavailable instead of leaking a traceback.
